title: Men's Sneakers – Lightweight with EVA Cushioning
descriptionHtml:
Your feet tally up the day at nine in the evening

All day on hard floors, then a gym session, then home – in shoes where every step comes straight through. It's not your legs that are tired. It's the cushioning that's missing.

The solution: an EVA sole that takes the impact for you

Lightweight sneakers with a shock-absorbing EVA midsole and a durable TPU outsole. A breathable fabric upper with laces keeps your feet cool at the gym, on the jogging route and through the whole everyday in between.

Features

  • Takes the impact with every step – EVA midsole
  • Good grip – durable TPU outsole
  • Cool even after the workout – breathable fabric upper
  • Low-cut model with classic lacing
  • For the gym, jogging and everyday wear – autumn and winter alike

Changing your mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
